description: This PHP source file defines the WorkshopTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer and provides methods to transform a Workshop model, including retrieving info and actions related to a workshop.

classes.name: WorkshopTransformer
classes.description: A class for transforming Workshop models, providing methods to retrieve information and actions for a workshop.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with the workshop title wrapped in strong HTML tags.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of action URLs for editing, translating, and previewing the workshop based on user permissions.
